verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for a digital-administration portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no public API. Keyless probes found only a ~3 KB JavaScript shell, with every transaction behind an account, and the parent ministry site behind a Cloudflare challenge. Nothing documents programmatic access to any UI action.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
